question: expected tokens/USD per hour for Dev and Ops baselines inside the VM vs today's cloud hubs; cost drivers; cuts; budget
agree: cost today is dominated by context re-read, not by work: cache_read is ~74% of hub cost (R0); the old dev hub 01Vtf8Jh read 36.0M cache tokens for 11.35 USD, worker-GA57 24.5M for 10.52 USD (ops/flow/measure/last.json)
a VM baseline only pays off as an event-driven loop of fixed-size cards, not as a long conversation; with that shape the coordination cost drops by an order of magnitude
disagree: moving today's hub conversations into the VM unchanged would not save tokens; the saving comes from removing the conversation (cards + rules), wherever it runs
missing: per-call measurement on the VM (needs the DEV-VMAUTO gateway); today's numbers are session lifetime averages from cloud usage
the user's budget (ASK-VM-COST constraint: no continuous VM model until set)
facts: model call sites that stay after R1-R4 + VMHUB (rules cannot decide them): 1) building/editing code for a spec (worker) - largest, per item; 2) intake: user words -> candidate spec/1 (DEV-BASEAUTO), only when the user writes; 3) diagnosis on needs_judgment: a failing test or incident whose cause is not matched by a rule (each repeat becomes a rule, 0 calls); 4) design opinions (opinion/1) on request
zero model calls by design: verdict + integration (DEV-R3-DET), watching (DEV-WATCH), routing/batching order, successor prompt + assign swap + digest (DEV-BASEAUTO), commit/push gates (VMHUB rev3)

estimate (not measured): coordination as cards ~10-20 calls/h when active x ~10-20k tokens on Sonnet-class -> ~0.2-0.6 USD/h for Dev+Ops together, ~0 when idle; vs today's cloud hubs 6-11 USD/h each at 200-330k ctx
build cost per item measured roughly 1.7 USD (R0a, short worker) to 10.5 USD (GA57, long worker); long workers cost mostly re-read
risk: estimates are unvalidated until the gateway meters per call; a judgment loop without a rule-cache can still grow cost; Opus for routine calls multiplies cost ~5x
first_step: land R0-baseline, then R1 gateway (DEV-VMAUTO) with budgets; measure one day of the VM loop in shadow before any VM baseline runs continuously

proposal_budget.model_default: cheapest that passes; Opus only for design opinions and diagnosis
